description: Create the mobile Supabase client. Independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 (touches only the app/ directory). Adds app/src/lib/supabase.ts using @react-native-async-storage/async-storage for session persistence, and notes the required npm install for @supabase/supabase-js inside app/.
steps: Run 'cd /Users/aryansinghthakur/Downloads/Veducore/app && npm install @supabase/supabase-js@2.57.4' to add the Supabase client to the mobile app. This pins to the same version (^2.57.4) used by the web app.

Create app/src/lib/supabase.ts with the following content — use the real URL and anon key from the web .env file (https://cdxvtpelytopdunvwvvl.supabase.co and the full JWT from VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY): import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage'; import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'; const SUPABASE_URL = 'https://cdxvtpelytopdunvwvvl.supabase.co'; const SUPABASE_ANON_KEY = '<full anon key from .env>'; export const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, { auth: { storage: AsyncStorage, autoRefreshToken: true, persistSession: true, detectSessionInUrl: false } });

Verify the mobile TypeScript config accepts the new file by running 'cd /Users/aryansinghthakur/Downloads/Veducore/app && npx tsc --noEmit'. The mobile tsconfig.json at app/tsconfig.json should include app/src.
acceptance_criteria: app/src/lib/supabase.ts exists and exports a supabase client configured with AsyncStorage.
